title.en: Edge provenance for intramolecular and illustrative connections

summary: Confirm that guide edges are authored typed references to atoms rather than inferred from an unstated distance cutoff.
objective: Every edge carries two atom references, a type and a provenance, and endpoints follow their atoms when molecules move.
applies_when: A scene draws associations between molecules in addition to covalent bonds.
Molecules or groups can be moved, rotated or duplicated.
A viewer might read an illustrative connection as a measured interaction.
intent_signals: the dashed lines stayed behind when I moved the molecule
are these hydrogen bonds inferred or authored
example_prompts: Check how the intermolecular guide edges in this water network were decided.

principles: An intermolecular guide edge is authored data with a purpose; it is not the output of a distance threshold, and no universal cutoff exists to substitute for that decision.
Covalent bonds within a molecule and illustrative associations between molecules are different edge types with different endpoints and rendering, so the model must carry the type.
Endpoints are references to atoms, so moving a molecule updates its guides automatically; an edge drawn from copied positions becomes false as soon as anything moves.
implementation: Store each edge as two atom references plus a type and a provenance note, and forbid any construction path that infers edges from distance without an explicit labelled rule.
Translate and rotate one molecule, then re-read every edge endpoint from the model to confirm it still refers to the same atoms and follows them.
Select one edge of each type and read back both endpoint molecule identifiers and the edge type.
If a distance-based helper is used while authoring, record its cutoff and mark the resulting edges as inferred so the artifact never presents them as measured.
observable_checks: Every edge resolves to two atom references and a declared type; an edge without provenance fails even when it looks reasonable.
After a molecule is moved, all of its guide endpoints follow, and a selected edge reports the correct pair of molecule identifiers.
No panel presents an inferred edge as a measured or predicted interaction, and any authoring cutoff is reported together with the edges it produced.

known_limits: Checks data provenance and reference integrity; it does not establish that the illustrated associations occur in a real sample.
Authored verification guidance; no scene was run or rendered for this record.
creative_affordances: Adapt the scenario, scale and presentation to your subject; this record fixes what must be checked, not how the scene must look.
